cohort: 30 twelve-month-old infants (16 born to mothers with GDM, 14 born to mothers without GDM)
finding: While maternal GDM status was associated with reduced gut microbiome diversity in infants at 12 months of age, it had limited impact on the overall structure and function of the developing microbiome compared to the influence of delivery mode and infant sex.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery had a significant impact on the expression of multiple bacterial pathways in the infant gut microbiome.
